challenge_title: Enterprise AI Customer Support Platform GTM & Expansion
raw_business_case: SupportScale AI is a B2B SaaS startup launching an autonomous customer support agent platform for mid-market e-commerce brands. The company has $60,000 in remaining seed runway over the next 6 months. Competitors currently charge $1,500/month flat fee. SupportScale's current customer acquisition cost (CAC) is estimated at $600 per account with an average contract value (ACV) of $12,000/year. The leadership team must decide whether to launch an aggressive direct outbound sales campaign (high upfront ad spend) or a partner-led referral ecosystem with Shopify app agency integrators. Success requires achieving break-even within 8 months while preserving cash runway.
sample_surprise_event: SURPRISE EVENT RELEASE: Main competitor SupportBot AI has suddenly slashed prices by 50% to $750/month and launched a free 90-day trial for e-commerce brands. Concurrently, Google Ads acquisition CAC has spiked by 40% across B2B SaaS categories.
